correctness.rationale: For each n>=5 checked the exact b-action simultaneously on sources 0 and 2. Oriented descending gap recurrence excludes b(0),b(2) simultaneous no-gap moves, with admissible contraction sites L={0,2} except d=2 and n-2. Explicit u_d,v_d satisfy the recurrence; monotonicity and Bellman potential G(pair)<=1+G(a pair),1+G(b pair) rule out gap-increasing shortcuts, and the four critical starting phases yield sharp parity diameter. Independently constructed reverse pair graph and BFS checked ALL unordered pair distances for n=5..60 against the closed formula, not merely source verifier logs. All-n proof depends on closed symbolic parity/four-phase reduction.
